phpstan-tree-builder.scope: Concrete roots, seven node types, prototypes and repeated end() calls. No analyzer implementation copied.

psalm-configuration.scope: Array and enum prototypes. No analyzer implementation copied.

psalm-container-service.scope: Class-string service lookup and preservation of undefined-method diagnostics.

psalm-container-xml.scope: Service ids and aliases. The local JSON map replaces the XML input; XML parsing is outside this extension.

symfony-node-builder.scope: Symfony 6.4.50. append() sets a child parent only when the builder itself is parented.

symfony-container.scope: Symfony 6.4.49. Registered service ids are arbitrary strings; only flag 1 throws for an unknown id.

symfony-container-builder.scope: Symfony 6.4.49. get()/doGet() throw for missing definitions with flags 0 and 1.

symfony-service-locator.scope: Symfony 6.4.49. ServiceLocator implements ServiceProviderInterface and overrides get().

psalm-console-option.scope: Console options declared via addOption('--name') with leading dashes and setDefinition([...]).

psalm-header-bag.scope: HeaderBag::get() returns string when a non-null string default is supplied.

phpstan-form-get-errors.scope: FormInterface::getErrors($deep, $flatten) returns FormErrorIterator<FormError> unless $deep is true and $flatten is false.

psalm-form-get-errors.scope: FormInterface::getErrors() iteration yields FormError unless called with (true, false).

psalm-serializer.scope: SerializerInterface::deserialize() and DenormalizerInterface::denormalize() return type inference from $type.

psalm-abstract-controller.scope: AbstractController::$container and #[Required] setter methods are initialized by Symfony DI autowiring.

symfony-serializer-interface.scope: Real Symfony SerializerInterface contract verified alongside Symfony 6.4 and 7.4 Serializer/Denormalizer runtime tests.

symfony-token-interface.scope: TokenInterface::getUser() returns ?UserInterface; narrowed when MAGO_SYMFONY_USER_CLASS is configured.

phpstan-private-service.scope: Private services cannot be fetched directly via public ContainerInterface::get(); no analyzer implementation copied.

symfony-input-argument.scope: InputArgument::setDefault() rejects non-null defaults for REQUIRED and non-array defaults for IS_ARRAY.

symfony-input-option.scope: InputOption::__construct() and setDefault() reject invalid VALUE_NONE/VALUE_IS_ARRAY/VALUE_NEGATABLE combinations and defaults.

symfony-request.scope: Request::getRequestFormat() and getPreferredFormat() return string whenever $default is omitted or non-null string.

symfony-response-header-bag.scope: ResponseHeaderBag::getCookies() returns list<Cookie> for COOKIES_FLAT and nested domain/path/name Cookie arrays for COOKIES_ARRAY.

symfony-console-application.scope: Application::getDefaultHelperSet() registers formatter, debug_formatter, process, and question helpers.

cases.title: Explicit service maps override class-name inference
cases.semantics: An interface-shaped service id may map to a concrete implementation. A configured target absent from the codebase must not fall back to the id class.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Resolve the mapped implementation; retain mixed for a missing mapped class and unknown ids.
cases.negative_control: Call a method absent from the concrete service; use a map target missing from the codebase.
cases.versions: Mago 1.60.2; Symfony Config 6.4.50, DependencyInjection 6.4.49, service-contracts 3.8.1, psr/container 2.0.2. Runtime and analyzer checks passed on PHP 8.3 and 8.4; matching CI configured. PHPStan and Psalm themselves were not executed.
cases.derivation: Adapted class-string and alias cases, with local audit regressions for precedence and invalid targets.

cases.title: Numeric string service ids survive JSON loading
cases.semantics: PHP converts numeric JSON object keys to integer array keys when decoding associatively. Symfony accepts the original string id.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Resolve id 42 to Mailer from the committed map.
cases.negative_control: Call greet() on the Mailer returned for id 42.
cases.versions: Mago 1.60.2; Symfony Config 6.4.50, DependencyInjection 6.4.49, service-contracts 3.8.1, psr/container 2.0.2. Runtime and analyzer checks passed on PHP 8.3 and 8.4; matching CI configured. PHPStan and Psalm themselves were not executed.
cases.derivation: Local audit edge case extending the upstream service-id scenario; upstream tests do not assert numeric JSON keys.

cases.title: ServiceLocator and ServiceProviderInterface retain mapped types
cases.semantics: The existing PSR method target also matches ServiceProviderInterface and ServiceLocator overrides. No separate provider is needed.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Valid mapped calls pass on both types.
cases.negative_control: Missing service methods remain non-existent-method; unknown locator ids remain mixed-method-access.
cases.versions: Mago 1.60.2; Symfony Config 6.4.50, DependencyInjection 6.4.49, service-contracts 3.8.1, psr/container 2.0.2. Runtime and analyzer checks passed on PHP 8.3 and 8.4; matching CI configured. PHPStan and Psalm themselves were not executed.
cases.derivation: The upstream get() contract is adapted to installed Symfony service providers. Audit confirmed existing target inheritance.

cases.title: Container invalid-reference flags preserve possible null
cases.semantics: Base Container returns null for an absent service with flags 0, 2, 3 and 4; flag 1 throws. ContainerBuilder throws for both 0 and 1. Interface receivers conservatively include null for flag 0 despite conditional PHPDoc.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Flag 1 is non-null. Builder 0|1 unions are non-null. Nullable flags and unknown int values retain possible null; reordered named arguments resolve by name.
cases.negative_control: Unguarded nullable accesses report at all eight sites; a missing service method with flag 1 still reports.
cases.versions: Mago 1.60.2; Symfony Config 6.4.50, DependencyInjection 6.4.49, service-contracts 3.8.1, psr/container 2.0.2. Runtime and analyzer checks passed on PHP 8.3 and 8.4; matching CI configured. PHPStan and Psalm themselves were not executed.
cases.derivation: Local runtime-backed flag matrix extends the upstream known-service get() contract and corrects the prototype.

cases.title: All built-in node types return through their actual builder
cases.semantics: scalar, boolean, integer, float, enum, variable and array nodes have different methods and share the builder parent. node() accepts named type and name arguments.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Type each concrete node and return to the builder with end(), including nested array prototypes.
cases.negative_control: Call children() on non-array nodes, min() on boolean or array nodes, or values() on an integer node.
cases.versions: Mago 1.60.2; Symfony Config 6.4.50, DependencyInjection 6.4.49, service-contracts 3.8.1, psr/container 2.0.2. Runtime and analyzer checks passed on PHP 8.3 and 8.4; matching CI configured. PHPStan and Psalm themselves were not executed.
cases.derivation: Adapted from the pinned PHPStan fluent chain; variableNode and named node() arguments extend its matrix.

cases.title: Unknown NodeBuilder parents remain nullable
cases.semantics: A standalone NodeBuilder and a node produced by that unparented builder end at null. A provider cannot distinguish an unknown externally parented builder or NodeDefinition parameter from a standalone one on Symfony 6.4/7.2 (before @template TParent = null).
cases.analyzer_expectation: Preserve nullable fallback for untracked builders and their children; delegate untracked NodeDefinition::end() to Symfony's declared return type instead of fabricating null (preventing false method-access-on-null on externally parented parameters such as SecurityBundle CustomAuthenticatorFactory). Tracked children() chains and Symfony 7 ArrayNodeDefinition<null> stay precise.
cases.negative_control: Dereference end() on a standalone builder or its scalar node. The original custom builder fixture no longer assumes a fabricated array parent.
cases.versions: Mago 1.60.2; Symfony Config 6.4.50, DependencyInjection 6.4.49, service-contracts 3.8.1, psr/container 2.0.2. Runtime and analyzer checks passed on PHP 8.3 and 8.4; matching CI configured. PHPStan and Psalm themselves were not executed.
cases.derivation: Local audit counterexample to the upstream parented end() chains; exact null for standalone construction remains unavailable to this provider.

cases.title: Prototypes preserve array parents across end()
cases.semantics: Built-in prototype types and shortcut methods return their concrete node and end() returns the containing array, including uppercase type names.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Retain array methods after prototype end(), and return through nested children and node builders.
cases.negative_control: After scalarPrototype()->end(), min() is invalid because the receiver is the parent array.
cases.versions: Mago 1.60.2; Symfony Config 6.4.50, DependencyInjection 6.4.49, service-contracts 3.8.1, psr/container 2.0.2. Runtime and analyzer checks passed on PHP 8.3 and 8.4; matching CI configured. PHPStan and Psalm themselves were not executed.
cases.derivation: Adapted array and enum prototypes, expanded locally to all seven built-in types and shortcut combinations.

cases.title: Root-hook assignment tracking stops at function scopes
cases.fixture: <?php function scopes(): void { $tree = new \Symfony\Component\Config\Definition\Builder\TreeBuilder('root'); $factory = static function () { $tree = new \Symfony\Component\Config\Definition\Builder\TreeBuilder('inner', 'scalar'); return $tree; }; $factory(); $tree->getRootNode()->children(); }
cases.semantics: Local assignments and root-variable usages inside another function or closure do not change the outer scope binding.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Do not report children() on an outer array root due to an unrelated scalar closure variable. Do not check an unrelated closure parameter as the outer scalar root.
cases.negative_control: A nested array TreeBuilder or root assignment must not hide either of the two outer scalar-root children() errors.
cases.versions: Mago 1.60.2; Symfony Config 6.4.50, DependencyInjection 6.4.49, service-contracts 3.8.1, psr/container 2.0.2. Runtime and analyzer checks passed on PHP 8.3 and 8.4; matching CI configured. PHPStan and Psalm themselves were not executed.
cases.derivation: Local hook audit regression extending PHPStan non-array-root cases. This does not claim control-flow or by-reference capture analysis.

cases.title: Custom NodeBuilder subclasses and setNodeClass() mappings survive fluent chains
cases.semantics: NodeBuilder::setNodeClass() registers or overrides node classes for node() and shortcut methods, and NodeBuilder::append() clones the builder (class and node mappings) into nested BuilderAwareInterface array nodes.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Track custom setNodeClass() mappings across node(), built-in shortcuts, nested arrayNode()->children(), and prototypes; preserve custom NodeBuilder subclasses across setParent(), end(), and nested children(); keep unparented NodeBuilder chains nullable per SYMFONY-T002.
cases.negative_control: Unknown methods on custom node definitions, unmapped customSetting() on standard scalarNode(), invalid children() on overridden CustomScalarNodeDefinition, unknown methods after end(), and unparented setNodeClass() dereferences all report.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony Config 6.4 and 7.x.
cases.derivation: Wave 3 extension of TreeBuilder fluent tracking for custom NodeBuilder subclasses and setNodeClass() registrations.

cases.title: Compiled container XML resolves public, private, aliased, and factory services
cases.semantics: Compiled Symfony container XML declares public and private services, multi-hop aliases, and class/service factories whose return types can refine the service class.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Parse compiled XML dumps via MAGO_SYMFONY_CONTAINER_XML (or var/cache auto-discovery), resolve chained aliases with cycle protection, and refine factory services through codebase return types.
cases.negative_control: Wrong methods on aliased or factory-resolved services report non-existent-method; cyclic aliases safely degrade to mixed; runtime XmlDumper round-trip matches.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony 6.4 and 7.x container XML plus symfony/demo App_KernelDevDebugContainer.xml (1487 services).
cases.derivation: Replaces the prior JSON-only limitation with real Symfony XmlDumper container parsing.

cases.title: Container and ParameterBag parameter lookups resolve typed XML parameter values
cases.semantics: Compiled container XML carries scalar, collection, constant, binary, and typed %env(...)% parameters used via ParameterBagInterface::get(), ContainerInterface::getParameter(), and AbstractController::getParameter().
cases.analyzer_expectation: Resolve literal parameter keys to precise scalar, list, keyed-array, constant, or env-processor types while preserving Symfony's declared union for unknown keys.
cases.negative_control: Passing int parameter to strlen(), string parameter to intdiv(), or null parameter to strlen() reports invalid-argument/null-argument; unknown keys keep possible null/union diagnostics.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony 6.4 and 7.x.
cases.derivation: Extends container XML metadata to parameter resolution across Container, ParameterBag, and AbstractController.

cases.title: Console commands validate literal getArgument and getOption names against configure()
cases.fixture: <?php use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command; use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputArgument; use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface; use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface; final class Cmd extends Command { protected function configure(): void { $this->addArgument('username', InputArgument::REQUIRED); } protected function execute(InputInterface $in, OutputInterface $out): int { return $in->getArgument('username') !== null ? 0 : 1; } }
cases.semantics: Commands declaring static arguments and options in configure() via addArgument(), addOption() (including leading -- prefixes stripped by InputOption), or setDefinition([new InputArgument(...), new InputOption(...)]) fail at runtime when execute() requests an undeclared name.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Report unknown-console-argument and unknown-console-option for undeclared literal names on InputInterface receivers, normalize leading dashes on option names, extract literal InputArgument/InputOption entries from setDefinition([...]), accept standard Application options, and skip inherited or dynamic definitions.
cases.negative_control: TypoCommand and SetDefinitionTypoCommand report unknown-console-argument and unknown-console-option; ValidatedCommand (--bypass-locking), SetDefinitionCommand, and InheritedCommand produce zero issues; disabling extensions removes all four diagnostics.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony Console 6.4 and 7.x and Mautic 7.2.2.
cases.derivation: Mago SDK ReturnTypeProviderContext does not expose enclosing Command class, so static validation runs via ClassLikeAnalysisHook on Command descendants.

cases.title: HeaderBag::get() narrows return type to string when a non-null string default is supplied
cases.semantics: HeaderBag::get($key, $default) returns the string header value when present and $default otherwise. When $default is a non-null string, the result cannot be null (though an existing header may still be an empty string).
cases.analyzer_expectation: Return string when $default is any non-null string, and fall back to Symfony's declared ?string when $default is omitted or nullable.
cases.negative_control: Calling $headers->get('X-Missing') without a default still reports nullable-return-statement and invalid-return-statement when returned as string.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony HttpFoundation 6.4 and 7.x.
cases.derivation: Clean-room MethodReturnTypeProvider for Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\HeaderBag::get.

cases.title: FormInterface::getErrors() returns FormErrorIterator<FormError> for flat error iteration
cases.semantics: FormInterface::getErrors($deep = false, $flatten = true) yields FormError instances whenever $deep is false or $flatten is true, and yields FormError|FormErrorIterator only when $deep is true and $flatten is false.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Parameterize FormErrorIterator<FormError> when $deep is false/omitted or $flatten is true/omitted, and FormErrorIterator<FormError|FormErrorIterator> when $deep may be true and $flatten may be false.
cases.negative_control: Iterating $form->getErrors(true, false) and calling $entry->getMessage() reports non-existent-method on FormErrorIterator; disabling extensions reports invalid-iterator and non-existent-method on all getErrors() loops.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony Form 6.4 and 7.x.
cases.derivation: Clean-room MethodReturnTypeProvider supplying the missing @template generic argument on FormInterface::getErrors().

cases.title: SerializerInterface::deserialize() and DenormalizerInterface::denormalize() resolve target class and array types
cases.semantics: SerializerInterface::deserialize() and DenormalizerInterface::denormalize() hydrate an instance of $type (or an N-dimensional array-key-indexed array of $type for trailing [] suffixes such as Foo::class . '[]', preserving both integer and string keys).
cases.analyzer_expectation: Resolve literal class names and trailing [] array dimensions to Type::namedObject() or nested Type::array(array-key, ...) when the target class exists in the codebase.
cases.negative_control: Calling a nonexistent method on a deserialized object or array element reports non-existent-method on DomainEvent; disabling extensions reverts array notation to mixed-assignment and mixed-property-access; real Symfony Serializer runtime tests verify DomainEvent, DomainEvent[], associative keys, and DomainEvent[][].
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against real symfony/serializer on Symfony 6.4 and 7.4.
cases.derivation: Extends Psalm's class-string deserialization spec to also support Symfony's 'Foo[]' and 'Foo[][]' array type notation, backed by real symfony/serializer in require-dev.

cases.title: AbstractController::setContainer() and #[Required] methods are recognized as class initializers
cases.fixture: <?php use Symfony\Contracts\Service\Attribute\Required; final class Svc { private string $v; #[Required] public function init(): void { $this->v = 'ok'; } }
cases.semantics: Symfony DependencyInjection autowiring invokes methods marked with #[Symfony\Contracts\Service\Attribute\Required] (including AbstractController::setContainer()) before the service or controller is used.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Return setContainer on AbstractController subclasses and any method carrying #[Required] from ClassInitializerProvider so definite property assignments in those methods satisfy check-property-initialization.
cases.negative_control: Properties not assigned in any constructor or #[Required] method still report missing-constructor on UninitializedServiceNegative; disabling extensions reports missing-constructor on AbstractController subclasses and RequiredAutowiredService.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony 6.4 and 7.x.
cases.derivation: Uses Mago SDK ClassInitializerProvider and Codebase::findMethods(withAnyAttribute) to discover #[Required] initializers.

cases.title: Console argument and option mode/default contracts and getArgument()/getOption() SDK boundary
cases.fixture: <?php use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command; use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption; final class BadCmd extends Command { protected function configure(): void { $this->addOption('flag', null, InputOption::VALUE_NONE, '', false); } }
cases.semantics: InputArgument and InputOption reject invalid mode and default combinations at runtime (REQUIRED with non-null default, VALUE_NONE with non-null default, VALUE_IS_ARRAY without VALUE_REQUIRED/VALUE_OPTIONAL, VALUE_NEGATABLE with value-accepting mode, and scalar defaults on IS_ARRAY). Per-Command InputInterface::getArgument()/getOption() return-type narrowing requires enclosing Command class context.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Share ConsoleCommandDefinition between ConsoleCommandArgumentsHook checks and report invalid-console-input-definition on all 6 runtime-throwing mode/default combinations. Keep InputInterface::getArgument()/getOption() return-type narrowing unimplemented until Mago SDK ReturnTypeProviderContext exposes enclosing class or file context.
cases.negative_control: InvalidConsoleDefinitionsCommand reports 6 invalid-console-input-definition diagnostics; Wave5HelperCommand reports 0; runtime tests prove all 6 invalid definitions throw Symfony Console exceptions.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony Console 6.4 and 7.4; per-Command return-type narrowing blocked by Mago 1.60.2 ReturnTypeProviderContext.
cases.derivation: Shared ConsoleCommandDefinition model validates runtime-throwing mode/default rules; ReturnTypeProviderContext lacks enclosing class/file so return-type narrowing cannot be implemented soundly in Mago 1.60.2.

cases.title: Configurable Security getUser() narrows return type to configured UserInterface class
cases.semantics: AbstractController::getUser(), SecurityBundle\Security::getUser(), Security\Core\Security::getUser(), and TokenInterface::getUser() return ?UserInterface by default, and return ?ConfiguredUser in applications configured with one user class via MAGO_SYMFONY_USER_CLASS.
cases.analyzer_expectation: When MAGO_SYMFONY_USER_CLASS names an existing class or interface implementing UserInterface, narrow getUser() to ConfiguredUser|null; leave zero-config and invalid/non-UserInterface configurations unchanged.
cases.negative_control: Unguarded dereference reports possible-method-access-on-null and unknown methods report non-existent-method; unconfigured and non-UserInterface configs preserve UserInterface|null and reject custom methods.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony Security Core and SecurityBundle 6.4 and 7.4.
cases.derivation: Opt-in MethodReturnTypeProvider gated by MAGO_SYMFONY_USER_CLASS with codebase ancestry validation against UserInterface.

cases.title: Compiled container XML validates private service access and opt-in unknown service IDs
cases.semantics: Compiled Symfony container XML marks public services and aliases with public="true". Fetching a private service directly from ContainerInterface::get() or Container::get() throws ServiceNotFoundException outside ServiceLocator, ContainerBuilder, TestContainer, and TestCase subclasses. ContainerInterface::has() narrowing cannot be expressed in Mago 1.60.2 InvocationAssertions.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Report private-service-access on compiled XML containers for direct throwing ContainerInterface/Container::get() calls on private services/aliases, and report unknown-service-id when MAGO_SYMFONY_STRICT_CONTAINER_SERVICES=1 is enabled with throwing invalidBehavior, while skipping ServiceLocator, ContainerBuilder, TestContainer, PHPUnit TestCase subclasses, and non-throwing invalidBehavior flags.
cases.negative_control: ContainerXmlNegative reports 2 private-service-access errors (and 1 unknown-service-id in strict mode, skipping NULL_ON_INVALID_REFERENCE); ContainerXmlUsage (ServiceLocator, ContainerBuilder, AbstractController::$container, public alias) reports 0; symfony-demo corpus passes with 0 added issues.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony 6.4, 7.4, and symfony/demo App_KernelDevDebugContainer.xml.
cases.derivation: Extends ContainerXmlLoader and ServiceClassMap with service/alias visibility metadata and adds ContainerGetAccessHook; documents Mago 1.60.2 SDK boundary for has() narrowing.

cases.title: Request::getRequestFormat() and getPreferredFormat() narrow to string for non-null defaults
cases.semantics: Request::getRequestFormat(?string $default = 'html') and getPreferredFormat(?string $default = 'html') return a non-null string whenever $default is omitted or a non-null string, and return ?string when $default is null or nullable.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Narrow return type to string when $default is omitted or non-null string, and fall back to Symfony's ?string when $default may be null.
cases.negative_control: Calling getRequestFormat(null) or getPreferredFormat(null) retains nullable-return-statement and invalid-return-statement; disabling extensions restores 4 possibly-null-operand errors; eliminates 6 null-argument/operand false positives on Drupal 11.4.13.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony HttpFoundation 6.4 and 7.4.
cases.derivation: Empirically proven Mago 1.60.2 gap on Symfony 6.4 and 7.4; SessionInterface::get() and InputBag::get() were rejected as unsound because stored null or arbitrary values bypass defaults at runtime.

cases.title: ResponseHeaderBag::getCookies() returns list<Cookie> or nested Cookie map by format
cases.fixture: <?php function nestedCookies(\Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\ResponseHeaderBag $h): void { foreach ($h->getCookies(\Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\ResponseHeaderBag::COOKIES_ARRAY) as $paths) { foreach ($paths as $cookies) { foreach ($cookies as $c) { $c->getName(); } } } }
cases.semantics: ResponseHeaderBag::getCookies($format = self::COOKIES_FLAT) returns list<Cookie> for COOKIES_FLAT ('flat') and array<array-key, array<array-key, array<array-key, Cookie>>> for COOKIES_ARRAY ('array') because PHP converts numeric-string cookie names and domain/path keys to int, whereas Symfony's docblock declares only Cookie[].
cases.analyzer_expectation: Return list<Cookie> when $format is omitted or 'flat' and nested array-key-indexed Cookie arrays when $format is 'array'.
cases.negative_control: Calling missing methods on flat or nested Cookie elements reports non-existent-method; disabling extensions triggers non-iterable-object-iteration and invalid-iterator on COOKIES_ARRAY loops.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony HttpFoundation 6.4 and 7.4.
cases.derivation: Clean-room MethodReturnTypeProvider fixing Symfony's inaccurate @return Cookie[] docblock for COOKIES_ARRAY.

cases.title: HelperSet::get() and Command::getHelper() narrow built-in Symfony Console helpers
cases.semantics: Application::getDefaultHelperSet() registers formatter (FormatterHelper), debug_formatter (DebugFormatterHelper), process (ProcessHelper), and question (QuestionHelper). Narrowing assumes these four built-in helper names are not remapped to unrelated classes at runtime.
cases.analyzer_expectation: Narrow literal calls to HelperSet::get() and Command::getHelper() for the 4 built-in helper names when the target helper class exists in the codebase.
cases.negative_control: Calling an unknown method on $helpers->get('question') reports non-existent-method on QuestionHelper; disabling extensions restores 4 less-specific-argument and 1 less-specific-return-statement diagnostics.
cases.versions: Verified on Mago 1.60.2 / PHP 8.3 against Symfony Console 6.4 and 7.4.
cases.derivation: Clean-room MethodReturnTypeProvider matching Symfony Console Application::getDefaultHelperSet().
